story.title: Pip's First Pair

panels.desc: A bright morning in the Pair Forest. The friends walk back along the mossy path past the four doors they have opened — the round door in the giant tree, the door in the hollow log, the little door in the rock and the small door by the pond — each standing open and glowing softly; the letter pairs carved on the doors (s h, c h, t h, c k) are the ONLY text allowed in the picture. Bun counts the doors on her paw; Hedgie carries the toy ship; Beads rides on Hedgie's flower; the three chipmunks, the Duck King and the moth follow in a line; Pim and Pam fly side by side; Pip hops behind. Hidden in the picture: the toy ship, a shell, the bench, the duck. Grumble does NOT appear. (The little king is the Duck King: a small yellow duck with a tiny golden crown — an animal, not a human.)
panels.ko: 아침 산책. 지금까지 연 문 넷을 세어요. 다람쥐들, 오리 왕, 나방이 줄지어 따라와요.

panels.desc: Pip stands alone on a mossy stump in front of the first door with its eyes squeezed shut and feathers trembling, beak open, trying with all its might; two separate little puffs come out of its beak. Pim and Pam sit right in front of Pip, side by side, showing how to say it together; Bun and Hedgie hold their breath with paws over their mouths; the Duck King watches hopefully. Hidden in the picture: the thin path, a round wooden bathtub by the stream, the moth, a striped sock. Grumble does NOT appear. (The little king is the Duck King: a small yellow duck with a tiny golden crown — an animal, not a human.)

lines.ko: 핍이 해 봐요. 또 해 봐요.

panels.ko: 핍이 그루터기 위에서 눈을 꼭 감고 애써요. 핌과 팜이 "같이 해!" 모두 숨을 참아요.

panels.desc: Just then, from high in the giant tree, Grumble leans out and gives his biggest Shh! — and Pip, copying him, says the sound in one smooth breath for the first time: Pip glows bright gold with a swirl of sparkles bursting from its beak; the first door flings wide open again with a rush of leaves; Pim and Pam leap up together cheering; Bun and Hedgie jump with arms up; Beads clicks all its beads in a happy arc. Hidden in the picture: the fish leaping in the stream, the shell shop, a white dish.
panels.ko: 그때 그럼블이 "쉬잇!" — 핍이 따라 하자 처음으로 "sh!" 한 소리로 나왔어요! 핍이 금빛으로 빛나고 모두 환호해요.

panels.desc: Dusk, the sky deep blue. Grumble has climbed halfway down the giant tree and sits on a low branch holding his lantern up so its warm glow lights the path and the open doors; his face is calm and he gives a small, proud smile. Pip sits on Bun's head, still glowing softly; Hedgie waves up at Grumble; Pim and Pam snuggle together on the lantern hook; the Duck King, wearing his ring, sings beside the pond with music notes floating up and his wings spread. Far off in the trees, a big round wall clock with no numbers hangs on a trunk, its two hands stopped. Hidden in the picture: the ring, the little king, the song notes, a wing. (The little king is the Duck King: a small yellow duck with a tiny golden crown — an animal, not a human.)
panels.ko: 해질녘, 그럼블이 나무 중간까지 내려와 등불로 길을 비춰요. "쉿이 바로 sh!" 그럼블이 껄껄 웃어요. 멀리 나무에 걸린 시계가 똑… 딱… 멈췄어요.

story.synopsis_ko: 친구들이 지금까지 연 문 넷을 세며 산책해요. 핍이 온 힘을 다해도 "스… 흐…" 따로따로. 그때 그럼블의 "쉬잇!"을 따라 하자 처음으로 "sh!" — 핍의 첫 짝꿍 소리예요! 해질녘 그럼블이 등불로 길을 비추며 껄껄 웃어요.
story.so_far_ko: 오리 왕의 반지를 양말 속에서 찾아 줬어요. sh·ch·th·ck·ng 짝꿍 다섯을 배웠어요.
story.goal_ko: 짝꿍 소리를 복습하고 핍의 첫 짝꿍 소리를 들어요.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation: the old raccoon in the tree gives a big shush, the baby bird copies him and bursts into golden light with sparkles swirling from its beak, the round door flings open with a rush of leaves, the twin bluebirds leap up together and the friends cheer. Camera still. Joyful, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle picture-book animation at dusk: the raccoon on a low branch slowly raises his lantern and its warm glow spreads along the path and the open doors; far off, the hands of a big wall clock on a tree trunk twitch and stop. Camera still. Calm, warm, child-friendly. No text.
